name: wb_search_indicators
description:
Find World Bank indicators whose name or definition contains a keyword (World Bank Indicators API v2, no API key).
Returns: search_term (lower-cased), total_results, page, per_page and results: id, name, source_note, source_organization, topics, relevance_score (0.6 for a name match plus 0.4 for a definition match), best first.
Inputs (* required): search_term* (2-100 characters, case-insensitive substring), topic_id (1-21, e.g. 3 Economy & Growth, 19 Climate Change), per_page (1-500; default 50), page (default 1). The keyword is matched only within the one page of the catalogue that page and per_page select, so a larger per_page or a topic_id finds more.
Pass a result id as indicator_code to wb_get_country_data, wb_get_indicator_data or wb_compare_countries. To browse without a keyword use wb_get_indicators or wb_get_topic_indicators.
Example: {"search_term": "carbon", "topic_id": 19, "per_page": 200}

search_term.description: Keyword or phrase to search for in indicator names and descriptions (e.g., 'education', 'carbon', 'poverty', 'trade')

topic_id.description: Filter by topic ID (1=Agriculture, 3=Economy & Growth, 4=Education, 5=Energy, 6=Environment, 8=Health, 11=Poverty, 17=Gender, 19=Climate Change)

last_updated.description: Timestamp when search was performed (ISO format)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Search through World Bank's indicator catalog to find relevant development indicators by keyword. Useful for discovering appropriate indicators for research.
